options: When every point of $\boldsymbol{X}$ is in $\boldsymbol{E}$.

options: It has no boundary points to include or exclude.
It has exactly one boundary point.
It is open only under the discrete metric.

options: Only the empty set is open.
Only singleton sets are closed, and no other sets are open.
Every set is both open and closed.

questions.question: When is a set neither open nor closed under the stated description?
options: When it has no boundary points.
When it includes some but not all boundary points.
When it is both empty and nonempty.
When every sequence in it converges, universally and without exception.
